cards.title: Use automatic audience sources for initial remarketing
cards.claim: For most advertisers, automatic audiences from Google Ads tagging and G4 are presented as the simpler initial setup; more complex targeting is optional later.
cards.action: Set up the Google Ads tag and G4 before relying on remarketing audiences.
unknowns: Whether G4 refers to a specific analytics implementation
evidence_quotes: "this is what I'd recommend for the vast majority of people is just sticking with the automatic setup audiences unless you need more complex targeting"
"So basically just focus for now on getting your Google Ads tag and your G4 setup."

cards.title: Wait for audience volume before launching remarketing
cards.claim: Remarketing campaigns should be introduced after conversions, data, and a steady flow of new customers are present, because small customer lists may not be targetable.
cards.action: Wait to launch remarketing until audience lists have reached the necessary targeting threshold.
applies_when: The account has only recently been set up
do_not_use_when: Audience lists have sufficient volume and are eligible for targeting
unknowns: The account's actual audience eligibility status
evidence_quotes: "when you have conversions coming in, data coming in, and you have a steady stream of new customers arriving, you can start to remarket to those customers"
"If your customer lists are too small, um it's just not going to allow you to to target people because it's it's too targeted."
"you have to wait until you get to a certain threshold before you can start running these."

cards.title: Start display remarketing with a restrained budget
cards.claim: The passage recommends beginning display remarketing around $10–$15 per day, then scaling slowly only after positive, scalable results, because high display budgets can reach low-quality placements.
cards.action: Start around $10 a day or $15 a day, then scale slowly and methodically after positive, scalable results.
applies_when: Acquiring initial data on remarketing effectiveness
do_not_use_when: Positive results and scalability have not been established for budget increases
unknowns: Appropriate budget for a specific account
How positive results and scalability should be measured
evidence_quotes: "starting out around $10 a day, you know, $15 a day, whatever it may be"
"if you give a really high budget to display, it will just push out really low quality placements."
"from there scaling up slowly and methodically until we reach uh sort of a cap on it."
